content.comment_body: Hello, I am using [product_name] [article_no] 12/24Vdc with [product_name] [version_no] software, on two laptops (one Dell and one Toshiba) running Windows 8.1. My operating systems do not recognize the device through Ethernet. I have followed tutorials and tried various suggestions, but I am unsure what is causing the issue. Any help would be highly appreciated.
Have you installed the [product_name] software as an administrator and are you running it with administrator rights?

The video attached demonstrates whether your PC can detect the device on the network. If the device is found, the IP address and subnet mask will be displayed. Both the device and PC must be on the same IP address range, and their subnet masks must match.
Yes, I installed and started Windows and [product_name] [version_no] with administrator rights. However, the Windows test reports 'No Access to Network' and the device test indicates 'Network OK'.
When following the video instructions, does the device appear as shown? Please provide a screenshot for reference.
I've attached screenshots with my current configuration.

The device's default IP is 192.168.0.1 with a subnet mask of 255.255.255.0. The PC and gateway seem to be set with the same IP address as the device, which is not correct. Only the first three segments of the IP address should be the same, with the fourth segment different, for example: PC 192.168.0.10, device 192.168.0.2, both with subnet mask 255.255.255.0. Is there a router or gateway on your network? You can modify the device's IP address using its display.
The issue has been resolved. Thank you very much for your assistance!

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered difficulties connecting [product_name] ([article_no]) to laptops via Ethernet using [product_name] [version_no] on Windows 8.1. The main challenge was due to incorrect IP addressing and network configuration, rather than a software error. Diagnostic feedback from the device and user support helped resolve the issue after clarifying the necessary network settings.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple Ethernet connectivity and reliable recognition between hardware, software, and the operating system, following standard tutorials and setup procedures.
